description: Figure: co-occurrence of DpaA-like hydrolases and L,D-transpeptidases across 22 gammaproteobacterial reference proteomes
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd
rows=[
 ("Pseudomonas putida KT2440",1,1,["PP_1451"],["PP_2320"]),
 ("Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1",1,2,["PA3756"],["PA0732","PA2854"]),
 ("Pseudomonas fluorescens",1,2,[],[]),
 ("Pseudomonas syringae DC3000",1,1,["PSPTO_1461"],["PSPTO_2270"]),
 ("Pseudomonas protegens",1,2,[],[]),
 ("Pseudomonas entomophila L48",1,2,[],[]),
 ("Stutzerimonas stutzeri A1501",1,3,[],[]),
 ("Azotobacter vinelandii DJ",1,3,[],[]),
 ("Escherichia coli K-12",1,5,["b0224"],["b0819","b1990","b0925","b1678","b1113"]),
 ("Salmonella Typhimurium LT2",2,5,[],[]),
 ("Klebsiella pneumoniae",1,5,[],[]),
 ("Yersinia pestis CO92",1,1,[],[]),
 ("Serratia marcescens",1,3,[],[]),
 ("Vibrio cholerae N16961",1,2,[],[]),
 ("Shewanella oneidensis MR-1",1,3,[],[]),
 ("Legionella pneumophila",2,7,[],[]),
 ("Coxiella burnetii RSA493",2,6,[],[]),
 ("Xanthomonas campestris",1,1,[],[]),
 ("Haemophilus influenzae Rd",0,1,[],[]),
 ("Acinetobacter baumannii",0,2,[],[]),
 ("Moraxella catarrhalis",0,2,[],[]),
 ("Francisella tularensis SCHU S4",0,0,[],[]),
]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["organism","DpaA_like","LDTPase_like","d","t"])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,7.2))
y=np.arange(len(df))[::-1]
ax.barh(y-0.18,df.DpaA_like,height=0.34,color="#2166ac",label="DpaA/LdtF-like hydrolase (Cys+2 $\\neq$ Arg, PTHR36699)")
ax.barh(y+0.18,df.LDTPase_like,height=0.34,color="#b2182b",label="L,D-transpeptidase (Cys+2 = Arg)")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(df.organism,fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("number of YkuD (PF03734) genes per reference proteome")
ax.set_title("Every genome carrying a DpaA-like hydrolase also carries at least one L,D-transpeptidase\n"
             "P. putida KT2440 has the minimum pair: one of each",fontsize=11,loc="left")
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9,loc="lower right")
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
for i,(yy,r) in enumerate(zip(y,df.itertuples())):
    if r.DpaA_like==0 and r.LDTPase_like>0: ax.text(r.LDTPase_like+0.15,yy,"no hydrolase",fontsize=8,va="center",color="#777")
ax.axhline(y[0]+0.6,color="k",lw=.4)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(f"n genomes with DpaA-like>0: {(df.DpaA_like>0).sum()}; of these, with >=1 LD-TPase: {((df.DpaA_like>0)&(df.LDTPase_like>0)).sum()}")
print(f"n genomes with LD-TPase but no DpaA-like: {((df.LDTPase_like>0)&(df.DpaA_like==0)).sum()}")
